assetProvenance.generationMethod: 24 dedicated image generations, three states per word, using the accepted Xiaohei identity only as a generation reference
assetProvenance.runtimeSourceScan: all runtime state sources and storyboard image layers resolve under public/assets/replica/ten-tain-v2

notes: All eight word scenes use a newly generated three-file pose set made for this episode and preserve the approved solid Xiaohei identity on transparent 16:9 canvases.
The key poses cut directly before, during, and after the semantic action; no full-canvas mechanical overlay is used.
The asset contact sheet and mobile reduction were checked before render; each word has a distinct local action and prop arrangement.
No runtime source points to an earlier episode directory; old episode images remain only in work/experiments/ten-tain-v1-legacy-assets as an archive.

shots.visualAction: The character gathers three blank note cards and closes them into an orange folder held against the chest.
shots.purpose: Shows checked information staying with the holder instead of slipping away.

shots.visualAction: The character guides six blue cubes over the rim of an orange tub until every cube is inside.
shots.purpose: Makes the idea of something being kept within a boundary concrete.

shots.visualAction: A small stack is arranged and held upright as a stable result.
shots.purpose: Uses a stable built arrangement to represent keeping a condition in place.

shots.meaning: get and take possession of something
shots.visualAction: A capsule is transferred from an opened box into the receiver's hand.
shots.purpose: Shows an item becoming available to and held by the receiver.

shots.visualAction: The character plants both feet at a blue boundary and stops an orange ball from crossing.
shots.purpose: Uses a clear boundary and stopped motion to convey being held back.

shots.visualAction: A Xiaohei pushes scattered pieces into a supported, organized result.
shots.purpose: Shows effort being held up and guided toward a stable target.

shots.visualAction: Two Xiaohei exchange a bright object and keep the interaction going.
shots.purpose: Represents attention being held through an engaging exchange.

shots.meaning: hold yourself back from an action
shots.visualAction: The character pulls both hands back and turns away from an untouched orange sweet on a tray.
shots.purpose: Shows deliberate restraint by leaving the tempting object alone.
